name: Lysergic acid dipropylamide
summary: Lysergic acid dipropylamide (LSDP), also known as N,N-dipropyllysergamide (DPL), is a psychedelic drug of the lysergamide family related to lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD). It is the analogue of LSD in which the amide group has two propyl substitutions instead of two ethyl substituents.

pharmacology.text: Its psychedelic effects were also reported by Hofmann.

uses.en: It is mainly of research interest as an LSD analogue and has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它主要作為 LSD 類似物而具研究價值，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它主要作为 LSD 类似物而具研究价值，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about its effects in people. Psychedelic lysergamides such as LSD can cause anxiety, confusion, paranoia, nausea, a faster heart rate and dilated pupils, and may trigger psychosis in people prone to it.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。LSD 等迷幻類麥角醯胺可能引起焦慮、混亂、偏執、噁心、心跳加快與瞳孔放大，也可能誘發易感者的精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。LSD 等迷幻类麦角酰胺可能引起焦虑、混乱、偏执、恶心、心跳加快与瞳孔放大，也可能诱发易感者的精神病。

fact.en: It differs from LSD only in carrying two propyl groups on its amide instead of two ethyl groups, and Albert Hofmann reported that it has psychedelic effects.
fact.zh: 它與 LSD 唯一的差別是醯胺上接的是兩個丙基而不是兩個乙基，艾伯特．霍夫曼曾報告它具有迷幻作用。
fact.zhHans: 它与 LSD 唯一的差别是酰胺上接的是两个丙基而不是两个乙基，艾伯特．霍夫曼曾报告它具有迷幻作用。
